items.html: And you must also know that only on the first day, before the Shofar blast, were the Gevurot sawed and given to the Nukva by Ima, without the agency of ZA. But after the Shofar blast on the first day, every aspect of the sawing of the Gevurot and their giving to the Nukva is by ZA himself, without Ima, for after that blast Ima returned and spread within ZA. And even though we blow on the second day, it is for the aforementioned reason; but the judgments are not sawed after the Shofar blast of the first day except by ZA, and from him they are given to her.
